stories.title: Equal Justice or Political Payback? Federal Agents Raid Rep. Ilhan Omar's Home
stories.conservative_headline: Feds Move In: Omar's Citizenship Papers Under Criminal Investigation as Probe Targets Her Birth Date
stories.liberal_headline: Chilling: Trump's DOJ Raids a Sitting Congresswoman's Home as Trump Publicly Attacks Her Citizenship
stories.poll_question: Is the federal probe of Rep. Omar legitimate law enforcement?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Fraud allegations deserve investigation regardless of a suspect's political office.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Targeting a Trump critic weeks before midterms is authoritarian intimidation.

stories.title: Press Accountability or State Media Muscle? DOJ Opens Antitrust Probe Into TV Networks
stories.conservative_headline: Collusion Exposed: DOJ Investigates Whether Networks Illegally Coordinated a Boycott of the White House
stories.liberal_headline: Retaliation Dressed as Antitrust: Trump's DOJ Targets Networks That Defended Banned Reporters
stories.poll_question: Is the DOJ antitrust probe of networks about law or payback?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Coordinated corporate boycotts deserve antitrust scrutiny like any other industry.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Government punishing critical coverage is a direct First Amendment violation.

stories.title: Transparency or Executive Privilege? Supreme Court Takes Up Trump's Bid to Hide DOGE Records
stories.conservative_headline: Supreme Court Steps In: Justices Agree Presidential Advisers Shouldn't Face Endless Fishing Expeditions
stories.liberal_headline: What Are They Hiding? High Court Gives Trump Another Shot at Burying DOGE's Records From the Public
stories.poll_question: Should DOGE be subject to Freedom of Information Act requests?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Presidential advisers need confidentiality; FOIA doesn't reach the Executive Office.
stories.poll_option2_desc: An entity that fired thousands and killed contracts must answer to taxpayers.

stories.title: Humane Option or Coercing Kids? Administration Offers Migrant Children $3,000 to Self-Deport
stories.conservative_headline: Voluntary Departure: Admin Offers Cash and a Flight Home Instead of Years in Detention Limbo
stories.liberal_headline: Cash for Kids: Trump Officials Dangle $3,000 at Children as Young as Five to Abandon Legal Cases
stories.poll_question: Are cash self-deportation offers to migrant children acceptable?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Paid voluntary return beats prolonged detention and clogged immigration dockets.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Bribing kids to waive legal rights is exploitation, not immigration policy.

stories.title: Decisive Deterrence or Another Forever War? Trump Says Iran Decision Coming 'Very Soon'
stories.conservative_headline: Peace Through Strength: Trump Weighs Action as Iran Fortifies Nuclear Sites and Eyes Neighbors
stories.liberal_headline: War on the Ballot? Trump Teases Iran Escalation as Troop Deaths Climb Above Pentagon's Count
stories.poll_question: Should Trump escalate military action against Iran?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Iran's fortified nuclear sites and threats demand decisive American force.
stories.poll_option2_desc: More escalation means more dead Americans with no congressional authorization.

stories.title: Energy Realism or Rewarding Putin? Trump Defends Russia Diesel Deal Amid Sanctions Backlash
stories.conservative_headline: 'I Made the Right Choice': Trump Says Diesel Deal Will Cut Fuel Costs for Working Americans
stories.liberal_headline: Sanctions Law Shredded: Trump's Putin Diesel Pact Bankrolls the War He Promised to End
stories.poll_question: Was the Russia diesel agreement the right call?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Cheaper fuel for American families outweighs symbolic sanctions posturing.
stories.poll_option2_desc: The deal violates sanctions law and finances Russia's war on Ukraine.

stories.title: Working Economy or Squeezed Families? Democrats Seize Economic Edge as Inflation Runs Hot
stories.conservative_headline: Manufacturing Comeback: Trump Touts Job Gains and Investment as Banks Report Resilient Consumers
stories.liberal_headline: Voters Turn: Democrats Lead on the Economy for First Time Since 2012 as Grocery and Heating Bills Soar
stories.poll_question: Who do you trust more to handle the economy?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Manufacturing gains and investment prove the America First agenda works.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Stalled hiring and rising prices show Trump's economy failing families.

stories.title: Accurate Apportionment or Erasing Millions? Trump's Plan to Cut Noncitizens From the 2030 Census
stories.conservative_headline: Citizens First: Trump Moves to Stop Illegal Immigrants From Inflating Blue-State House Seats
stories.liberal_headline: Unconstitutional Power Grab: Trump Census Scheme Would Erase Millions of Residents From Representation
stories.poll_question: Should noncitizens be excluded from census apportionment counts?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Political representation should reflect citizens, not illegal border crossers.
stories.poll_option2_desc: The Constitution requires counting all persons; exclusion is a partisan rig.

stories.title: Routine Grounds Work or Vandalizing Public Land? Judge Halts Tree-Cutting at DC Golf Course
stories.conservative_headline: Judicial Overreach on the Fairway: Activist Judge Blocks Routine Improvements to a Federal Golf Course
stories.liberal_headline: 'Furious' Judge Stops Trump Crews From Clear-Cutting Mature Trees on DC Parkland Over a Holiday Weekend
stories.poll_question: Was the administration right to cut trees at the DC park?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Federal land upgrades shouldn't be hostage to last-minute environmental lawsuits.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Destroying public parkland without review deserved the court's emergency halt.

stories.title: Rooting Out Corruption or Protecting an Ally? White House Asks Guilfoyle to Resign Over $100K Allegation
stories.conservative_headline: Swift Action: White House Asks Guilfoyle to Step Down as She Disputes Allegations
stories.liberal_headline: Only After It Leaked: Guilfoyle Pushed Out Over Alleged $100K Donor Ask as Senate Weighs Its Own Probe
stories.poll_question: Did the White House handle the Guilfoyle allegations properly?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Trump acted quickly once credible allegations against the ambassador surfaced.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Unqualified loyalist posts invite exactly this kind of ethical scandal.
